subject: Embed Redwood in SilkRoad Agent — OEM & UX/licensing scope
messages:
From: Evan Zhou <evan.zhou@silkroad.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Embed Redwood runtime into SilkRoad Agent — OEM inquiry

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for taking a look at this. We're exploring embedding a high-quality inference runtime into SilkRoad's enterprise assistant (desktop + cloud). A few quick asks to start:

- What OEM licensing models do you offer for embedding Redwood (upfront + royalty vs. flat capacity fee)?
- Do you support a fully white-label option (no Redwood branding) and a co-brand toggle?
- Technical: SDK for native embedding, offline packaging for on-prem customers, KMS/HSM support, and telemetry controls for PII.
- Data residency: many of our customers require EU residency and strict auditability.

We'd like a short scoping doc and a proposed MPA + SOW template so procurement can review. Can we target a pilot with ~50k MAU, 10 qps sustained, 200k tokens/day?

Attaching a short product brief for context.

Best,
Evan
Head of Partnerships — SilkRoad Systems
[Attachment: SilkRoad_Embedding_Brief.pdf]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Evan Zhou <evan.zhou@silkroad.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embed Redwood runtime into SilkRoad Agent — OEM inquiry

Evan — great to meet you and thanks for the clear asks. High-level responses below; I copied Vanessa (partnerships) to capture commercial/technical checklist items.

Quick answers:
- Licensing: we offer three OEM paths — Hosted API with OEM branding, Dedicated reserved capacity (monthly commit), and Private (VPC / on-prem) with per-seat or per-query licensing. We can model royalty or fixed fee depending on minimums.
- White-labeling: supported. We have a co-brand toggle on the SDK and options to remove Redwood product strings from the UX.
- SDK & packaging: we provide a runtime SDK with sample native wrappers and an offline packaging option for air-gapped installs (Private).
- Data residency & compliance: Redwood Private supports region pinning (eu-west-1) and KMS integrations; we also provide SOC2 artifacts and can do an SOC2 review.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Vanessa will send an SDK integration checklist + MPA template.
2) We map expected QPS/token volumes to a pricing scenario and draft an SOW + term sheet.
3) Technical POC call (include Marcus from our eng team) to validate KMS, telemetry controls, and packaging.

Attaching our OEM one-pager and a starter MPA.

Talk soon —
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_OEM_OnePager.pdf]

Subject: Re: Embed Redwood runtime into SilkRoad Agent — OEM inquiry (SDK + timeline)

Evan / Kimberly — quick notes from partnerships/ops side:

- Integration checklist: attaching a suggested timeline and technical checklist. Typical embed path (hosted -> dedicated -> private) takes 6–10 weeks depending on SSO/KMS and on-prem packaging.
- Branding: we support a "hide vendor" flag in the SDK; for full white-label we include a branding addendum in the MPA.
- Security: please send over the security questionnaire (we can pre-populate SOC2 reports). For EU residency, we recommend Private with region pinning for initial pilot.
- Commercial: we often start pilots under a short-term commitment (90 days) with a discounted pilot rate and then convert to a committed Dedicated capacity or licensing with revenue share.

I've attached the OEM_SDK_Integration_Checklist.xlsx and a sample pilot MPA timeline.

Action items:
- Evan: confirm pilot volume assumptions (MAU, QPS, token/day).
- Marcus: we'll need an engineering sync to confirm SDK binary size, dependency constraints, and packaging options.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: OEM_SDK_Integration_Checklist.xlsx]

Subject: Re: Embed Redwood runtime into SilkRoad Agent — OEM inquiry (pilot numbers + procurement)

Thanks — confirmed pilot targets below:
- Estimated initial pilot: 50k MAU, peak 12 qps, steady-state 6 qps, ~220k tokens/day.
- Primary requirement: EU residency for all EU customer traffic; must be auditable.
- Branding: white-label by default; co-brand toggle for joint customers.
- Procurement: attaching a purchase order stub to start procurement review. Grace Li (cc) will lead contracting.

Two commercial questions up front:
1) Can Redwood provide a one-time integration credit and a discounted pilot rate?
2) What are typical revenue share percentages (if we choose royalty model) or minimums for dedicated capacity?

Appreciate the quick turnaround —
Evan
Head of Partnerships — SilkRoad Systems
[Attachment: SilkRoad_PO_stub.pdf]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Evan Zhou <evan.zhou@silkroad.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embed Redwood runtime into SilkRoad Agent — technical notes

Evan — looping in a few technical clarifications before the POC call: 

- Model distribution: do you plan to host the model weights inside SilkRoad's environment (Preferred for Private) or call Redwood-hosted endpoints? The license differs.
- Quantization: we allow partner-side quantization for Dedicated and Private under the OEM agreement; for hosted models we restrict binary modifications.
- Telemetry & logs: Redwood SDK can redact PII fields before telemetry. We export metrics and sanitized logs to a partner-controlled S3 (or EU storage). Need to confirm the retention window.
- KMS/HSM: Redwood Private supports customer-managed keys (AWS KMS/HSM integrations). For air-gapped installs we provide a signed runtime binary and local key management hooks.
- Offline packaging: we can provide a prebuilt package for your on-prem customers but it requires an export compliance review (we'll share the checklist).

Propose a technical sync Wednesday 10/13 09:00 AM CET to walk through integration checklist and sample SOW.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Engineering Manager, Runtime — Redwood Inference
